projects.title: Data Hygiene Toolkit
projects.description: A comprehensive data validation and standardization tool built with FastAPI and PostgreSQL, featuring 30+ validation rules and Power BI integration for data quality monitoring.
features: Modular validation system with 30+ built-in rules
Editable grid interface for efficient data correction
Power BI dashboards for rule-wise metrics and anomaly tracking
Support for multiple export formats (CSV, Excel, JSON)
User-friendly interface for managing validation workflows
projects.technologies: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Angular, Power BI, Python, TypeScript
projects.fullDescription:
A comprehensive data hygiene solution designed to improve data quality through validation, standardization, and monitoring. The tool provides a modular framework for defining and applying data quality rules across various datasets.

Key Features:
- Modular validation system with 30+ built-in rules for common data quality checks
- Editable grid interface for efficient data review and correction
- Comprehensive Power BI dashboards for monitoring data quality metrics
- Support for multiple export formats (CSV, Excel, JSON)
- User management and permission system for team collaboration

Technical Implementation:
- Backend: FastAPI with PostgreSQL for data storage and processing
- Frontend: Angular with Material Design components
- Analytics: Power BI integration for data visualization
- Deployment: Containerized with Docker for easy deployment

This tool helps organizations maintain high-quality data by providing a centralized platform for data validation, cleaning, and monitoring.

A modern, performant portfolio website showcasing my projects, skills, and experience. The website is built with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.

Key Features:
- Server-side rendering for optimal performance and SEO
- Responsive design that works seamlessly across all device sizes

This project demonstrates my frontend development skills and attention to detail in creating modern web experiences.

projects.title: InsightBot – AI-Powered University Chatbot
projects.description: A Streamlit-based chatbot that helps international students explore universities by budget, weather, and field, with personalized recommendations using OpenAI API and ChromaDB.
features: Personalized university recommendations based on budget and preferences
Integration with OpenWeather API for climate information
Cost and job data analysis across 25+ US states
Context-aware responses using ChromaDB for knowledge retrieval
User-friendly interface for exploring educational options
projects.technologies: Python, Streamlit, OpenAI API, ChromaDB, OpenWeather API
projects.fullDescription:
InsightBot is an AI-powered chatbot designed to assist international students in making informed decisions about their higher education in the United States. The application provides personalized recommendations based on various factors including academic preferences, budget constraints, and lifestyle considerations.

Key Features:
- Natural language processing for intuitive user interactions
- Context-aware recommendations using OpenAI's language models
- Integration with OpenWeather API for climate information
- Comprehensive database of universities with detailed program information
- Cost of living and job market analysis for different regions

Technical Implementation:
- Frontend: Streamlit for rapid application development
- AI: OpenAI API for natural language understanding and generation
- Database: ChromaDB for efficient vector storage and retrieval
- External APIs: OpenWeather for climate data, various sources for cost and job data

This project demonstrates my ability to build practical AI applications that solve real-world problems by combining multiple technologies and data sources.
